The '''Taylander shuttle''' was an independent [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="TCG" /> that began production just after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
The Taylander [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was a mass-produced model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], independent of faction or allegiance. The vessels had a rounded bow and three landing struts,<ref name="TCG" /> and were 43.5 meters in length.

==History==
Taylander shuttles were a common sight in docking bays on such [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the leadup to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the Clone Wars, one of the shuttles were used to send the [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="HOBS">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] in such a shuttle.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars Insider 63|''Star Wars Insider'' 63]] incorrectly identifies the Taylander shuttle and the [[Gozanti-class cruiser/Legends|Gozanti Cruiser]] as "Brocklander ships." [[Star Wars Insider 65|''Star Wars Insider'' 65]] corrects the mistake, stating that "Brocklander" was only a nickname used during production.
